sentence_stem: If I had known about the meeting,
correct_completion: I would have come on time.
full_sentence: If I had known about the meeting, I would have come on time.
acceptable_variants: I would have been on time.

options.text: I will come on time tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: The third conditional needs 'would have' plus a past participle in the result clause, not a future tense about tomorrow.

options.text: I come on time every day.
options.why_wrong: The present simple does not match the past perfect in the if-clause; the result must describe an imagined past outcome.

options.text: I would have come on time.

options.why_wrong: This is a past perfect form that states a fact about the past instead of the imagined result the sentence needs.

grammar_focus: Third conditional: 'if' + past perfect, 'would have' + past participle
explanation: The stem uses the third conditional to talk about an imagined past situation. The result clause must use 'would have' followed by a past participle, such as 'come' in its past participle form.
translation: Gdybym wiedział o spotkaniu, przyszedłbym na czas.
